scripts.build: npm run build -w @coderlifenet/form-core && npm run build -w @coderlifenet/form-postgres && npm run build -w @coderlifenet/form-server && npm run build -w @coderlifenet/form-react && npm run build -w @coderlifenet/form-builder && npm run build -w example-minimal && npm run build -w example-workspace
scripts.pack:artifacts: rm -rf tmp/packs && mkdir -p tmp/packs && npm pack -w @coderlifenet/form-core --pack-destination tmp/packs && npm pack -w @coderlifenet/form-postgres --pack-destination tmp/packs && npm pack -w @coderlifenet/form-server --pack-destination tmp/packs && npm pack -w @coderlifenet/form-react --pack-destination tmp/packs && npm pack -w @coderlifenet/form-builder --pack-destination tmp/packs
scripts.dev:infra: docker compose up -d postgres localstack localstack-init
